in_hebrew.name: פיורנצו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם פיורנצו מקורו בשפה האיטלקית ומשמעותו 'פרח', 'לפרוח', הקשור לשגשוג ופריחה. באספקט הרוחני, הוא מייצג התפתחות וצמיחה רוחנית.

in_greek.name: Φιορέντζο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φιορέντζο προέρχεται από την ιταλική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'άνθος', 'ακμή', 'ανάπτυξη'. Στην πνευματική διάσταση, αντιπροσωπεύει την πνευματική ανάπτυξη και την εξέλιξη.

in_latin.name: Fiorenzo
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Fiorenzo origine italicum habet et significat 'flos', 'florens', 'prosperitas'. In aspectu spirituali, repraesentat incrementum et progressionem spiritualem.

in_english.name: Fiorenzo
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fiorenzo originates from Italian and means 'blooming', 'flourishing', or 'prosperity'. Etymologically, it is linked to the Latin words 'flos' and 'florens', signifying growth and abundance. In a spiritual context, Fiorenzo represents spiritual growth, development, and a prosperous life. Historically, the name has been used in Christian traditions to symbolize a life of virtue and spiritual flourishing.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fiorenzo holds an Italian cultural significance. It is an Italian masculine name meaning 'flowering'. The name is popular in Italy as well as amongst people of Italian descent due to its charming and romantic sound.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Fiorenzo represents more than just a pretty name. It symbolizes the renewal, revival, and spiritual growth that comes from a deep and abiding faith. Naming a child Fiorenzo would be a beautiful reminder of the transformative power of God in our lives. Several Christian saints have named Fiorenzo, emphasizing the spiritual significance of the name and offering a connection to the faith's rich history.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fiorenzo was an Italian monk and scholar in the 13th century. The name Fiorenzo carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
